_about: Help contacts for Tanzania, imported with `php artisan aisa:import-contacts` (add --update to refresh unverified entries). Researched online on 2026-10-17 from official websites (hospital .go.tz sites, TCRA numbering plan, C-Sema, TAWLA, LHRC, WLAC) and an embassy doctors list; each entry's source_note says where. EVERY entry is imported UNVERIFIED and is hidden from the public until a staff member calls it, confirms the details and presses Verify in Admin > Crisis contacts. Websites can be out of date.

contacts.name: Police
contacts.description_sw: Dharura ya polisi.
contacts.source_note: Short code from the TCRA national numbering plan (Wikipedia 'Telephone numbers in Tanzania' cites TCRA, 2022 and July 2025). Checked 2026-10-17. Before verifying: call from each network and confirm it is free and answered. Note: reports say 112 is less reliable outside Dar es Salaam.

contacts.name: Child Helpline (C-Sema)
contacts.description_en: Children, young people and anyone worried about a child; also reports of violence. WhatsApp: +255 624 100 100.
contacts.description_sw: Watoto, vijana na yeyote mwenye wasiwasi kuhusu mtoto; pia taarifa za ukatili. WhatsApp: +255 624 100 100.
contacts.source_note: C-Sema website sematanzania.org (116 free, 24/7; WhatsApp +255624100100; office +255 22 293 6576), UNFPA and UN News reports. Checked 2026-10-17.

contacts.name: Afya Call Centre (Ministry of Health)
contacts.description_en: Health information, health emergencies and psychological support. SMS: 15061.
contacts.description_sw: Taarifa za afya, dharura za afya na msaada wa kisaikolojia. SMS: 15061.
contacts.source_note: TCRA numbering plan (199 Afya call centre) and Ministry of Health statement, September 2025 (SMS 15061). Checked 2026-10-17.

contacts.name: Police Gender and Children Desk (Dawati la Jinsia na Watoto)
contacts.address: At police stations: ask at the front desk.
contacts.description_en: Officers trained to receive reports of violence against women and children.
contacts.description_sw: Maafisa waliopewa mafunzo ya kupokea taarifa za ukatili dhidi ya wanawake na watoto.
contacts.source_note: Gender desks operate in police stations (academic and UNFPA sources). No direct number found. Checked 2026-10-17. Add local desks with station phone numbers as they are confirmed.

contacts.name: One Stop Centres for survivors of violence
contacts.address: In some regional referral hospitals: ask at the hospital.
contacts.description_en: Medical, police and social welfare help in one place. Go within 72 hours after sexual violence if you can.
contacts.description_sw: Msaada wa afya, polisi na ustawi wa jamii mahali pamoja. Nenda ndani ya saa 72 baada ya ukatili wa kingono ikiwezekana.
contacts.source_note: No official list of centres found. Checked 2026-10-17. Confirm which hospitals have one and add them individually.

contacts.name: District Social Welfare Officer (Afisa Ustawi wa Jamii)
contacts.description_en: Child protection, child maintenance, family disputes and referrals.
contacts.description_sw: Ulinzi wa mtoto, matunzo ya mtoto, migogoro ya familia na rufaa.
contacts.source_note: Public information. Checked 2026-10-17. Add district offices with numbers as they are confirmed.
